```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(stringr)
library(posterior)

```

# Specify Data Posterior 

```{r}
# using wight = 1
#data_posterior <- sum_df_one
fit_w_one_v2 <- read.csv("/Users/finleyjean/Documents/STEPPS-prediction-Ecology/data/simple_stan_outputs/stan_simple_varve_v2")
data_posterior <- fit_w_one_v2

# using weight = 1, and outping r_new
fit_w_one_v4 <- read.csv("/Users/finleyjean/Documents/STEPPS-prediction-Ecology/data/simple_stan_outputs/stan_simple_varve_v4")
data_posterior <- fit_w_one_v4

# define look up table: 
taxa_names <- c("ash","beech","birch","elm","hemlock","maple","oak","other.conifer","other.hardwood","pine","spruce","tamarack") 
```


# Plot g[k,t]; log latent abundance

```{r}
g_long <- data_posterior %>%
  filter(str_detect(variable, "^g\\[")) %>%
  mutate(
    k = as.integer(str_extract(variable, "(?<=g\\[)\\d+")),
    t = as.integer(str_extract(variable, "(?<=,)\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    taxon_name = factor(taxa_names[k], levels = taxa_names)
  )

label_df <- g_long %>%
  group_by(taxon_name) %>%
  filter(t == max(t)) %>%   # get last time point for each Taxa
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(mean))       # order by final proportion (high → low)

taxa_order <- label_df$taxon_name

g_long$taxon_name <- factor(g_long$taxon_name,
                                    levels = taxa_order)

ggplot(g_long, aes(x = -t, y = mean, color = factor(taxon_name))) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  
  labs(title = "Latent log-abundance (g)", color = "Taxon") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + theme_minimal()

```


# Plot mu_t[k, t]; temporal trend

```{r}
mu_t_long <- data_posterior %>%
  filter(str_detect(variable, "^mu_t\\[")) %>%
  mutate(
    k = as.integer(str_extract(variable, "(?<=mu_t\\[)\\d+")),
    t = as.integer(str_extract(variable, "(?<=,)\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    taxon_name = factor(taxa_names[k], levels = taxa_names)
  )


ggplot(mu_t_long, aes(x = t, y = mean, color = taxon_name)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +  # Thicker lines
  geom_text_repel(
    data = mu_t_long %>% group_by(taxon_name) %>% slice_tail(n = 1),  # last point per taxon
    aes(label = taxon_name),
    nudge_x = 1.4,             # move text slightly to the right
    direction = "y",
    hjust = 0,
    segment.color = NA,        
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(title = "Temporal Trend", x = "Time", y = "Mean", color = "Taxon") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

```{r}

taxa_names <- c("ASH", "BEECH", "BIRCH", "ELM", "HEMLOCK", "MAPLE", "OAK",
           "OTHER.CONIFER", "OTHER.HARDWOOD", "PINE", "SPRUCE", "TAMARACK")

r_new_long <- data_posterior %>%
  filter(str_detect(variable, "^r_new\\[")) %>%
  mutate(
    time_index  = as.integer(str_extract(variable, "(?<=r_new\\[)\\d+")),
    taxon_index = as.integer(str_extract(variable, "(?<=,)\\d+")),
    taxon_name  = taxa_names[taxon_index]
  )

r_new_plot <- r_new_long %>% filter(time_index <= 40)

label_df <- r_new_long %>%
  filter(time_index <= 40) %>%
  group_by(taxon_name) %>%
  filter(time_index == max(time_index)) %>%
  ungroup()

taxa_order <- label_df %>%
  arrange(desc(mean)) %>%
  pull(taxon_name)

r_new_plot <- r_new_long %>%
  filter(time_index <= 40) %>%
  mutate(taxon_name = factor(taxon_name, levels = taxa_order))


ggplot(r_new_plot,
       aes(x = -(time_index * 50),
           y = mean,
           color = taxon_name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Temporal Trend",
    x = "Time",
    y = "Mean",
    color = "Taxon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

# Reconstruct r_new; New Pollent Counts

- not working right now

```{r}

# Assuming `fit` is your Stan fit object
draws_r <- fit_w_one_v2_50yr$draws("r")  # [iterations x N*T x K]

r_df <- posterior::as_draws_df(draws_r)

r_long <- r_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("r["), names_to = "index", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    i = as.integer(gsub("r\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]", "\\1", index)),
    k = as.integer(gsub("r\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]", "\\2", index))
  ) %>% mutate(
    taxon_name = factor(taxa_names[k], levels = taxa_names)
  )


# posterior mean
r_summary <- r_long %>%
  group_by(i, taxon_name) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(value), .groups = "drop")

r_ci <- r_long %>%
  group_by(i, taxon_name) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value),
    lower = quantile(value, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(value, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(r_summary, aes(x = i, y = mean, fill = factor(taxon_name))) +
  geom_area() +
  labs(
    title = "Vegetation Composition Over Time",
    x = "Time",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Taxon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(r_ci, aes(x = i, y = mean)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~taxon_name) +
  theme_minimal()
```
